title: Entertainers Paradise! $6M Estate with Lagoon Pool
description:
Escape to your own private resort at this gated 10,000 sq ft Paradise Valley estate. With 6 bedrooms (4 en-suite), a Dolby surround theater, upstairs lounge, and a 1,200 sq ft game room featuring a Foresight Golf simulator, basketball hoop, gym equipment, and arcade games, there is something for everyone. Outside, enjoy PV is only lagoon-style pool (see Other Things to Note), heated spa, covered daybeds, outdoor dining, fire pit, and plenty of loungers and seating.

The space
Bedrooms & Layout
✔ 6 Bedrooms | 6 Bathrooms | 9 individual beds – Sleeps up to 16
✔ Expansive 850 sqft Primary Suite with infinity-edge soaking tub, oversized shower, fireplace, seating area & kitchenette
✔ 3 additional ensuite bedrooms—each spread apart for maximum privacy
✔ Multiple living spaces, including an upstairs lounge
✔ Dedicated upstairs wellness nook with yoga mats, weights, bands & stretching space

Kitchen & Living
✔ Gourmet chef’s kitchen with high-end appliances, two islands & fully stocked cookware
✔ Formal dining room perfect for celebrations
✔ Large main living room with sliders that open directly to the backyard for true indoor/outdoor flow

Entertainment & Recreation
✔ 10-seat theater with Sony 4K projection, Apple TV & Dolby Atmos—far above a typical rental setup
✔ Separate 1,200 sqft converted game suite offering:
  • Arcade games
  • Basketball
  • State-of-the-art Foresight Golf Simulator
  • Speed bag
  • State-of-the-art workout equipment
  • Dedicated central A/C

Outdoor Oasis
✔ One-of-a-kind lagoon-style heated pool (heat optional) with private beach entry
✔ Lush palms & landscape lighting for a true resort feel
✔ Spa tucked into the garden for a quieter retreat
✔ Massive circular fire pit with seating for the entire group
✔ BBQ island with bar seating & outdoor prep space
✔ Two covered cabanas, loungers & abundant seating areas
✔ Stunning upstairs balcony overlooking the pool and gardens- amazing coffee or sunset spot
✔ Outdoor dining under lantern-lit trees- beautiful evening ambiance

Privacy, Security & Location
✔ One of the most private accommodations in all of Scottsdale/PV
✔ Central to Old Town Scottsdale, dining, shopping & top hiking trails
✔ Ideal for family vacations, milestone celebrations, corporate retreats & relaxing group escapes

Guest access
Guests will have full, private access to the entire estate during their stay. Parking is in the circle driveway, access will be through the front door.

Other things to note
Pool Heat (Optional):
We offer pool heating at $100/night with a 3-night minimum. The system will typically maintain low to mid-80s during most months.
During the coldest part of the year (mid-December through January), overnight temperatures can cause the water to fall into the low 70s by morning. The heater will raise temperatures again during the day, but it will not remain at 85° around the clock. If this is important to you, we would recommend alternative properties. We do not provide refunds or credits for natural temperature fluctuation caused by cold desert nights.

Early Check-In / Late Checkout
These are based on cleaner availability only and are not guaranteed. Fee: $125 each.

Property Access
For security and privacy reasons, the exact address is released 4 days prior to arrival.

Service Providers schedule
The property requires weekly professional servicing: Pool, Spa, and Landscape maintenance occurs Tuesday & Wednesday. These visits are exterior only and do not require guest interaction.

Booking Requirements
✔ Primary guest must be at least 21 years old
✔ No third-party bookings or travel agencies
We generally do not host local residents and may ask about the purpose of your stay. We reserve the right to decline bookings where the use or group dynamics conflict with house guidelines. AZ TPT License #21598064

This was the perfect place to stay for a Bachelorette. The house is very big and there was plenty of space for everybody. The pool was great.
Great host very responsive, beautiful house would stay again!

Fantastic host and stunning property! Photos cannot do it justice, truly amazing! Ross was very friendly and accommodating. Location is in a great area and very close to the Scottsdale strip if that’s your thing.

We had a fantastic stay at Ross’s place! From the moment we arrived, everything was seamless. Check-in was incredibly easy with clear instructions, and Ross was always quick to respond and very friendly throughout our stay. The home was spotless, well-maintained, and looked exactly like the listing. Everything we needed was provided, and it truly felt like a comfortable home away from home. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
